title: Fluctuation dominated ligand binding in molten globule protein
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD和伞形采样研究熔球态α-乳清蛋白与油酸的配体结合，虽属蛋白-配体互作且方法可迁移，但对象非蛋白质-DNA体系，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A molten globule (MG) state is an intermediate state of protein observed during the unfolding of the native structure. In MG states, milk protein α -Lactalbumin (aLA) binds to oleic acid (OLA). This MG-aLA-OLA complex, popularly known as XAM-LET performs cytotoxic activities against cancer cell lines. However, the microscopic understanding of ligand recognition ability in MG state of protein is not yet explored. Motivated by this, we explore binding of bovine aLA with OLA (BAMLET) using all atom molecular dynamics(MD) simulations. We find the binding mode between MG-aLA and OLA using the conformational thermodynamics method. We also estimate the binding free energy using the umbrella sampling (US) method for both MG state and neutral state. We find that the binding free energy obtained from US is comparable with earlier experimental results. We characterize the dihedral fluctuations as the ligand is liberated from the active site of the protein using steered molecular dynamics. The long-live fluctuations occur near the ligand binding site, which eventually transfers towards Ca 2+ binding site as the ligand is taken away from the protein. TOC Graphic
abstract_zh: 熔融球状（MG）态是蛋白质在天然结构去折叠过程中观察到的中间状态。在MG态下，乳蛋白α-乳白蛋白（aLA）与油酸（OLA）结合。这种MG-aLA-OLA复合物，通常称为XAM-LET，对癌细胞系表现出细胞毒性活性。然而，关于蛋白质MG态中配体识别能力的微观理解尚未被探索。受此启发，我们利用全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟探索牛aLA与OLA（BAMLET）的结合。我们通过构象热力学方法确定了MG-aLA与OLA之间的结合模式。我们还使用伞形采样（US）方法估算了MG态和中性态的结合自由能。我们发现，从US获得的结合自由能与先前的实验结果相当。我们通过定向分子动力学表征了配体从蛋白质活性位点释放时的二面角波动。长寿命波动发生在配体结合位点附近，随着配体从蛋白质中移除，这些波动最终向Ca²⁺结合位点转移。TOC图形
